observed_failure.message: LibreOffice last observed phase: native-conversion-start. ValueError: The project directory does not exist.

concrete_source_path: The shared checked_directory guard converts a missing Path.is_dir snapshot into ValueError. An owned descendant can be recreated before the later _missing_transient_entry walk, which must refuse that now-live path. This source-timing path is reproduced by the authored real-filesystem regression; it is not asserted to be the exact unobserved path of the prior native failure.
repair: Add one private Office stage metadata guard using direct unfollowed lstat outcomes. It validates all path components and every ancestor, rejects symlink/reparse/type changes, and checks the retained private-root identity.

A missing root or ancestor is a ConversionError immediately. Only a missing owned descendant retains FileNotFoundError for the existing census disappearance handling; no generic live-entry ValueError is made acceptable.
Validate pending directories again immediately before enumeration. Measure file bytes from fresh lstat metadata, retain nlink==1, existing entry/depth/byte budgets, deadline and final root recheck.

The global audio.jobs path helpers, selected-runtime admission, intermediate/output admission, source/hash receipts, process owner, no-bytecode setting and full runtime inventory comparison are unchanged.

regression.behavior: Remove the real descendant, obtain a real False is_dir result, recreate it, and prove the unchanged global guard still refuses that ambiguous snapshot. Then require the stage census to measure the live reappeared contents through lstat, preserve the root/original bytes and still reject a one-byte-insufficient budget.

actual_ordinary_qualification.limits: Exact declared synthetic fixture population on the pinned LibreOffice26.2.7 Windows runtime; historical failures and diagnostic scope remain recorded.
